sentences.text: THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S.439 CR.P.C PRAYING TO ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN CR.NO.161/2023 OF THALAK P.S., CHITRADURGA FOR THE OFFENCE P/US/376(2)(n) OF IPC AND SEC.4,6,17 OF POCSO ACT 2012 AND SEC.9,10,11 OF PROHIBITION OF CHILD MARRIAGE ACT 2006 PENDING ON THE FILE OF SPECIAL II ADDL. DISTRICT AND SESSIONS JUDGE AT CHITRADURGA.

THIS PETITION COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY THE COURT MADE THE FOLLOWING:
 ORDER

The petitioner has filed this petition under Section 439 of Cr.PC for enlarging him on bail in Thalak Police Station, Chitradurga District in Crime No.161/2023 registered for the offences punishable under Section 376(2) (n) of Indian Penal Code, 1860, Sections 4 and 5 (J) (II) 5(L), 6, 17 of POCSO Act and Sections 9, 10 and 11 of Child Marriage Act, 2006 pending on the file of Special 2nd Additional District and Sessions Judge, Chitradurga.

entities.text: Special 2nd Additional District and Sessions Judge, Chitradurga
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: 2. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner, learned HCGP as well as counsel for respondent No.2- Minor Guardian of the victim.
Perused the records.
The affidavit of the minor guardian as well as the petitioner are also filed.

4. The allegations of the prosecution disclose that, on 14.8.2023, on counselling the victim who was in a District Hospital, the complainant who is CDPO came to know that the victim is below 18 years and her marriage was performed on 9.8.2022 with the petitioner and they led conjugal life which has resulted in giving birth to a child on 10.08.2023.
In this regard, on the basis of the complaint lodged by the CDPO, FIR came to be registered and subsequently, the charge sheet was also submitted.
5. The petitioner was arrested and was remanded to the custody.
He had approached the learned Special Judge for bail.
His bail petition came to be rejected.
Hence, he has approached this Court.
6. The allegations of the prosecution disclose that the petitioner has studied upto SSLC but could not complete SSLC.

It is also alleged, since the father of the victim was NC: 2024:KHC:15123 not keeping good health, her marriage was performed with the petitioner on 9.8.2022 and sixteen days Manjunatha @ M T Manjunatha vs The State By Thalak Ps on 16 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/150511599/

sentences.text: thereafter, the petitioner had physical relationship with the victim girl which has resulted in she becoming pregnant.
Hence, when she was admitted in the hospital, considering the age of the victim girl, matter was reported by the Medical Officer to CDPO who, after counselling the victim, lodged a complaint.
6. The affidavit of the petitioner as well as the affidavit of minor guardian disclose that they are willing to perform the marriage of the victim girl again.
The allegations of the prosecution is that marriage of the victim girl is already performed.
However, no complaint is lodged either by the family members of the victim girl or relatives but, the complaint has been lodged by the Child Development Project Officer of Chitradurga District.
Due to this case, the victim has become orphan as she does not have the security of her husband who is in custody.
Investigation is concluded and charge sheet has been laid.
Parties have also filed respective affidavits undertaking to perform the marriage after the victim attains the age of majority.
7. Looking to the facts and circumstances of the present case, I do not find any impediment to enlarge the petitioner on bail.
The apprehensions put-forth by the learned HCGP can be meted out by imposing certain conditions.
Hence, the petition deserves to be allowed.

Hence, I pass the following:
ORDER (a) The petition is allowed.

(b) The petitioner is ordered to be enlarged on bail in Crime No.161/2023 of Thalak Police Station, Chitradurga District on the file of II Addl.District and Sessions Judge,
Chitradurga in Crl.Misc.No.14/2024 on his executing a personal bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety for the like-sum to the satisfaction of the NC: 2024:KHC:15123 trial Court, subject to the following conditions:
 (i) He shall not indulge in  any of the criminal  activities.
 (ii) He shall not tamper  the prosecution witnesses  either directly or indirectly.
(iii) He shall co-operate  for speedy disposal of the  matter.
